# Hotel Valet Services RFP Template

## Executive Summary

This Request for Proposal (RFP) is issued by [Hotel Name] to solicit proposals from qualified parking service providers for comprehensive valet parking services. We seek a partner who can enhance our guest experience while optimizing revenue and operational efficiency.

## Hotel Information

**Property Details:**
- Hotel Name: [Insert Hotel Name]
- Address: [Insert Address]
- Number of Rooms: [Insert Room Count]
- Average Daily Rate (ADR): [Insert ADR]
- Occupancy Rate: [Insert Occupancy %]
- Parking Spaces Available: [Insert Space Count]

## Scope of Services

### 1. Guest Experience Requirements

**Service Standards:**
- White-glove guest service with professional uniformed staff
- Multilingual capabilities (minimum English + [local language])
- VIP and loyalty program member recognition
- Concierge-level assistance and local recommendations
- Professional appearance and demeanor at all times

**Operational Requirements:**
- 24/7 valet service availability
- Maximum 3-minute vehicle retrieval time
- Guest vehicle inspection and damage reporting
- Secure key management system
- Weather protection for guests during vehicle handoff

### 2. Revenue Management Expectations

**Revenue Optimization:**
- Dynamic pricing strategy based on demand and events
- Revenue per Available Space (RevPAS) maximization
- Minimum guaranteed revenue: $[Insert Amount] per month
- Revenue sharing model: [Insert Percentage]% to hotel
- Upselling opportunities (car washes, detailing, etc.)

**Financial Reporting:**
- Daily revenue reports by 9 AM
- Weekly performance analytics
- Monthly P&L statements
- Annual budget planning and forecasting

### 3. Technology Integration

**Property Management System (PMS):**
- Integration with [PMS System Name]
- Real-time room charge posting
- Guest folio integration
- Automatic billing reconciliation

**Mobile Technology:**
- Mobile app for pre-arrival parking requests
- Text-to-retrieve vehicle service
- Digital receipts and invoices
- GPS-guided directions to parking areas

### 4. Brand Standards Compliance

**[Hotel Brand] Standards:**
- Adherence to brand service standards
- Uniform specifications and appearance guidelines
- Guest interaction protocols
- Quality assurance and mystery shopper programs
- Brand-approved signage and materials

### 5. Event and Group Handling

**Special Events:**
- Wedding and banquet parking coordination
- Corporate event management
- Holiday and peak season staffing
- Group arrival and departure coordination
- Shuttle service to nearby venues (if applicable)

## Vendor Requirements

### 6. Insurance and Liability Coverage

**Required Coverage:**
- General Liability: Minimum $2,000,000 per occurrence
- Garage Keepers Liability: Minimum $1,000,000 per vehicle
- Workers Compensation: As required by state law
- Cyber Liability: Minimum $1,000,000 (for technology integration)
- Umbrella Policy: Minimum $5,000,000

**Additional Requirements:**
- Hotel named as additional insured
- 30-day notice of cancellation
- Waiver of subrogation
- Primary and non-contributory coverage

### 7. Staffing and Training

**Staff Requirements:**
- Background checks for all employees
- Drug testing program
- Professional appearance standards
- Customer service training certification
- Emergency response training

**Management Structure:**
- On-site manager during peak hours
- 24/7 management contact availability
- Regular staff performance reviews
- Continuous training programs

### 8. Performance Metrics and Reporting

**Key Performance Indicators:**
- Guest satisfaction scores (target: 95%+)
- Average vehicle retrieval time (target: <3 minutes)
- Revenue per available space (RevPAS)
- Damage claims ratio (target: <0.1%)
- Staff turnover rate (target: <20% annually)

**Reporting Requirements:**
- Daily operational reports
- Weekly performance dashboards
- Monthly guest satisfaction surveys
- Quarterly business reviews
- Annual service level agreement review

## Proposal Requirements

### 9. Company Information

Please provide the following information about your company:

- Company name, address, and contact information
- Years in business and parking industry experience
- Number of hotel properties currently serviced
- References from similar hotel properties (minimum 3)
- Financial statements (last 2 years)
- Organizational chart and key personnel bios

### 10. Service Proposal

**Operational Plan:**
- Detailed service delivery methodology
- Staffing plan and scheduling approach
- Training programs and certification processes
- Quality assurance and monitoring procedures
- Emergency response and incident management

**Technology Platform:**
- Description of technology systems and capabilities
- PMS integration process and timeline
- Mobile app features and functionality
- Reporting and analytics capabilities
- Data security and privacy measures

### 11. Financial Proposal

**Pricing Structure:**
- Management fee structure
- Revenue sharing percentages
- Guaranteed minimum revenue
- Additional service pricing (car wash, detailing, etc.)
- Implementation and setup costs

**Financial Projections:**
- 3-year revenue projections
- ROI analysis for the hotel
- Seasonal adjustment factors
- Event and peak pricing strategies

## Evaluation Criteria

Proposals will be evaluated based on the following weighted criteria:

1. **Guest Experience and Service Quality (30%)**
   - Service standards and protocols
   - Staff training and certification programs
   - Guest satisfaction track record
   - Brand standards compliance

2. **Revenue Generation Potential (25%)**
   - Revenue projections and guarantees
   - Pricing strategy and optimization
   - Upselling and ancillary revenue opportunities
   - Financial stability and performance history

3. **Technology Platform and Integration (20%)**
   - PMS integration capabilities
   - Mobile app features and user experience
   - Reporting and analytics functionality
   - Data security and compliance

4. **Company Experience and References (15%)**
   - Hotel industry experience
   - Similar property references
   - Financial stability and insurance coverage
   - Management team qualifications

5. **Implementation Plan and Timeline (10%)**
   - Transition planning and execution
   - Staff training and certification timeline
   - Technology integration schedule
   - Go-live readiness and support
